proposed_widenings.name: magic_item_variant_family
proposed_widenings.justification: The existing MagicItemRecord shape only supports one fixed rarity and one fixed mechanics payload per record. This unit is a single SRD family spanning three item variants whose attack-roll bonus changes with rarity, so one honest record needs a way to bind rarity and granted bonus together instead of collapsing to an arbitrary representative tier.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Wand, Uncommon (+1), Rare (+2), or Very Rare (+3) ... you gain a bonus to spell attack rolls determined by the wand's rarity.

notes: Did not author content JSON/Dhall. The passive-item family exists, but this combined +1/+2/+3 unit cannot be represented as one honest MagicItemRecord because rarity is a single fixed enum field and the roll bonus is a single fixed DiceDelta. The Half Cover clause was not treated as widening pressure; local precedent already treats cover-immunity riders as caller-owned/DM agenda.
